moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-control-heart-like, written here): Loop 2.8 s: the outline heart hides at 0.67 s (0.1 s); the filled heart (#ff8ca3) pops from 0.7 s: scale 0.65 → 1.14 in 0.2 s, to 1 in 0.22 s, fading in; 8 particles (4x7 px, r1, hues 35° + 36° each) from 0.78 s: scale 0.3 → 1 (0.11 s), fly radially to (cos a × 56 / 65 / 74, sin a × 37 − 18 px) rotating 39° × i by +0.56 s, then drift to ×1.12 / ×1.45 further, rotate 91° × i and fade by +1.46 s. Site runtime eases each segment in-out. Params: at · pop (0.65 → 1.14 → 1) · particles (8) · reach (56-74 px) · duration (1.46 s). The filled heart pops 0.65 → 1.14 → 1; eight particles (hues 35° + 36° each) fly out, rotate and fade by 1.46 s.
